- Secure chat assistant for ops floor (short-latency but higher priority on data isolation than millisecond latency).
- Embeddings index over 20TB of legacy PDFs and engineering notes for rapid retrieval in incident response.
- Reranking pipeline to prioritize incoming sensor reports.

- Validation gates: SBOM review, HSM integration test, PIV login, offline model checksum verification.
